text: Independent review of the in-flight whitener rename: provenance is correct - identity, explicit diag(n), and two distinct AR whiteners all yield different diagnostics$observation_whitener signatures, and numerically-equal-but-differently-constructed whiteners are correctly not identified. Maps are bitwise identical across observation_whitener and the deprecated alias; GLS/OLS agree with base qr.coef to 1.5e-16/8.3e-17.
